correctness.rationale: Exact polar radial identity plus finite edge decomposition. On unchanged facets p log(r_trans/r)=p log(1+a/p) gives W_i E. Vertex rays move by O(p^-1), their log ratio slopes are |v|² sinΔ/(h_i h_(i+1)), and rescaled interpolation yields Γ_i J. Uniform bounded derivatives over compact displacement sets control integrated remainder O(p^-2). Divergence gives logcosh leading term, and Taylor/monotonicity give positive Dirichlet quadratic and triangular odd cubic. Standard-library radial integration checks 3 polygons at 3 p-values and odd cubic at 2 scales.
